oneOf.description: Done (exit code 0). For a dry run: everything checked, nothing written.
Refused before anything was written (exit code 2).
The Component refused the input as one it does not support (exit code 2); nothing was written.
The program could not be verified against its checksum (exit code 3); it was not started.
A step failed (exit code 4); the Instance is as it was.
Cancelled (exit code 4); the Instance is as it was, and `--resume` continues.

ToolInfo.description: The Component program a driver runs.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that file, checked again right before it was started.

version.description: Its version as the program reported it in its result; `null` in the `started` event, before it ran.

code.description: The stable code callers match on.

message.description: Prose for people; never matched on.

ttwright_code.description:
For `ttwright_failed`, `unsupported` and `cancelled`: ttwright's own `error.code`, for example
`check_failed` or `unsupported_version`.

TtwErrorCode.description: The stable error codes of `raul ttw`. The exit code of each is in `contracts/README.md`.

oneOf.description: The Instance does not exist or cannot be opened (exit code 2).
The Profile does not exist (exit code 2).

A game folder or the TTW package was given neither as a flag nor in `raul config`, or is not what it
should be (exit code 2).
The Instance already has a `Tale of Two Wastelands` Mod (exit code 2).
No ttwright program: none is bundled next to `raul` and `--ttwright` was not given (exit code 2).
The ttwright program changed between its checksum and its start (exit code 3); it was not started.

ttwright could not be started, ended without a result, or printed one that is not a `ttwright-result`
(exit code 4).
ttwright printed a `ttwright-result` of a version this build does not read (exit code 2).
ttwright ran and failed (its exit code 1 or 2; exit code 4); `ttwright_code` says why.

ttwright does not support the package or one of its features (its exit code 3; exit code 2). Nothing was
written.
The run was cancelled (exit code 4); `--resume` continues it.
ttwright succeeded but adding its output to the Instance failed and was rolled back (exit code 4).

dry_run.description: A dry run: ttwright read the package and checked the game copies, and nothing was written.

files.description: Files in the Mod, or `null` when no Mod was added.

mod.description: The Mod added to the Instance (`Tale of Two Wastelands`), or `null` when none was.

plugins_enabled.description: The plugins the Profile enabled with the Mod, in load order.

profile.description: The Profile that got the Mod.

resumable.description: `raul ttw --resume` with the same arguments continues this run.

resumed.description: The run continued an interrupted one.

staging.description:
The folder ttwright wrote to. It is kept after a cancelled or failed run so `--resume` can continue there,
and removed after a successful one.

status.description: How the run ended; the same as the `finished` event's.

tool.description: The ttwright program that ran, or `null` when none did.

ttwright.description: The `ttwright-result` v1 document ttwright printed, as it printed it, or `null` when it printed none.
